turbine.name: IEA 15 MW reference turbine (IEA-15-240-RWT)
turbine.drivetrain: low-speed direct drive (no gearbox), PMSG outer rotor

thermal_model.provenance: illustrative — no public IEA 15 MW generator thermal data; rated rise ≈ 78 K (within the IEC 60034-1 class B rise on class F insulation)

fault_library.label: Aerodynamic efficiency loss
fault_library.advisory: Rotor delivers less aerodynamic power than the twin at the same wind. If ambient temperature is at or below 0 °C with high humidity, treat as rotor icing: check the ice detection system, apply the site ice-throw risk procedure before restart. Otherwise schedule a blade inspection for soiling or leading-edge erosion.
references: IEA Wind TCP Task 19 — International recommendations for ice-throw risk assessment (2018)

fault_library.label: Pitch angle misalignment
fault_library.advisory: Actual blade angle differs from the reported angle by a constant offset. Verify the zero-pitch calibration of all three blades (optical or photogrammetric pitch-angle check) and the pitch encoder reference.
references: IEC 61400-1:2019 — Design requirements, control and protection system

fault_library.label: Uncommanded power limitation
fault_library.advisory: Output is capped below rated although no curtailment set-point is active. Check converter and generator temperature derating, cooling circuit and the turbine alarm log; confirm with the park controller that no set-point was sent.

fault_library.label: Generator loss increase
fault_library.advisory: The direct-drive generator converts more power into heat than the twin expects — typical of stator-winding insulation ageing or inter-turn faults, weakened magnets (more current for the same torque) or main-bearing distress. Compare the stator-winding PT100s phase by phase, measure insulation resistance and polarisation index, and review main-bearing temperature and vibration.
references: IEC 60034-1:2022 — Rotating electrical machines: rating, thermal classes
IEEE Std 43-2013 — Testing insulation resistance of electric machinery
Tautz-Weinert & Watson (2017), IET Renew. Power Gener. 11(4) 382–394
fault_library.prognosis_limit_note: Illustrative end-of-life criterion: generator losses doubled (≈ +68 K stator winding at rated load in this model — beyond the class-F margin).

fault_library.label: Nacelle anemometer drift
fault_library.advisory: Nacelle anemometer reads differently from neighbouring turbines while the turbine itself behaves normally. Recalibrate or replace the sensor; power performance results based on it (IEC 61400-12-2) are invalid until corrected. Lost-production figures for this turbine use the corrected wind.
references: IEC 61400-12-2:2022 — Power performance based on nacelle anemometry

scenarios.name: healthy
scenarios.title: Healthy fleet
scenarios.description: No injected faults. Measures the in-control behaviour of the detector: any event raised here is a false alarm.

scenarios.name: rotor_icing
scenarios.title: Rotor icing
scenarios.description: Cold spell (−4 °C, RH ≈ 96 %) from 25 % to 70 % of the window. Ice accretes on WTG-05 to WTG-08 and removes 20–35 % of Cp, then sheds after the thaw. Severities are illustrative.

scenarios.name: pitch_misalignment
scenarios.title: Pitch misalignment
scenarios.description: WTG-20: blades sit 4° further towards feather than the encoder reports (e.g. a zero-pitch calibration error after a blade-bearing exchange), from 30 % of the window.

scenarios.name: converter_derating
scenarios.title: Converter derating
scenarios.description: WTG-28: uncommanded 12 MW active-power limit (e.g. converter cooling fault) from 40 % of the window.

scenarios.name: generator_degradation
scenarios.title: Generator degradation
scenarios.description: WTG-12: generator losses rise linearly from nominal (3.45 % of shaft power) to 1.6× from 15 % of the window — a progressive fault for prognosis.

scenarios.name: anemometer_drift
scenarios.title: Anemometer drift
scenarios.description: WTG-15: nacelle anemometer gain drifts to +8 % between 20 % and 60 % of the window. The turbine is healthy; only its wind reading is wrong.

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.title: Combined faults
scenarios.description: All five faults at once, on different turbines, during the cold spell — tests whether the twin isolates each one correctly.
